reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that status there is no redline and no counterparty comment — the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports the preferred position: no minimum volume, take-or-pay, shortfall or usage-cap obligation on us; Article 7.3 only contemplates a future supply agreement to be negotiated in good faith with no committed volumes, and the sales/marketing forecasts and net sales projections (p0370, p0371, p0373) are expressly non-binding.

p0488 gives Sanofi (our side) a unilateral termination-for-convenience right in its entirety or country/Product-by-Product, so even the ongoing funding obligations are exitable — well beyond the fallback's 12-month reducible commitment.

Rationale correctly notes that milestone/royalty and cost-share/diligence terms are activity- or achievement-based rather than volume or spend commitments, and defers those to other rules, avoiding double-flagging.
No deterministic check failures; compliant finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
